purpose: HSPICE .trannoise synthesizes flicker noise with a 1/f spectrum between FMIN and FMAX.

oracle.derivation: Drain flicker KF*ID/f into a 1k load: Var v(d1) = R^2 KF ID ln(FMAX/FMIN) (+0.2 % channel thermal); through a 10 MHz pole Var v(d2) = R^2 KF ID [ln f - ln(1+(f/fc)^2)/2] from FMIN to FMAX. Bands of 15 % and 20 % in variance cover the sample spread of a 20 us record (measured 2 % and 6 % rms over 12 seeds).

notes: Statistical acceptance interval over a fixed-seed run, not a prescribed noise waveform.
